name: Dragon Knight provisioning corporal
description: Adult human man in dragon-blazoned mail, narrow beard, dusty gloves. Leads a fresh provisioning detail at the Shoals on d-1 afternoon. No knowledge of Halla or earlier incidents.

extras.knowledge_limits: No recognition of Halla, sister, debt, paid guard network or previous Knight incidents.

passive_block.established: Free Ward Location after missed bash, before Halla's next attack
passive_block.expires: when shield is used to attack or actively parry

street_encounter.status: resolved; Dragon Knights withdrew; no injuries; boats and cargo secure

current_scene.personal_weapons: left with baggage, not available in current confrontation
current_scene.held_by: Captain Ward pending inquiry and return of Halla; no conviction

extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.

actor_notes: LOOKS: Adult man, narrow beard, mail and dragon badge, dusty leather gloves. CORE: Treats collecting company supplies as ordinary work and local consent as a delay. NATURE: Brisk, literal and impatient with wasted effort. WANTS: A loaded food boat and its crew for delivery to his company. PRESSURE: Repeats the company claim, then asserts rank, then tries to put hands on the boat if refusal persists; violence remains contingent on actual resistance and his decisions. SPEECH: Short work orders, ordinary nouns, no legal exposition, no cruelty speeches. Does not recognise Halla or know his friends, debt or previous incidents.
